predictions.text: I predict that STAN will win the second round run-off elections for Senate seats, securing eleven seats with ten held by STAN and one by SLK.
I predict that Florida and Alabama will report the highest number of damages assessed and recovery funds allocated.
I predict that Hurricane Simon makes landfall in Southern California.
I predict that the Houthis will launch another missile attack on Abha International Airport in Saudi Arabia, by the end of Sunday, 18 October 2026.
I predict that Russian forces will launch another ballistic missile attack on civilian targets in Ukraine, causing at least 28 casualties, similar to the attack in Pryluky, Chernihiv Oblast.

I predict that the Tigray Region will continue to experience strikes and casualties, with at least one more strike occurring in a different town or city within the region by the end of Sunday, 18 October 2026.
I predict that the total casualties reported from the drone strikes in Ad-Damazin and other locations in Blue Nile State will be at least 41.

I predict that the number of casualties and missing persons from the 2026 Panama earthquake will be updated, with at least several dozen people confirmed dead and hundreds still missing by the end of Sunday, 18 October 2026.
I predict that the Delhi Jantar Mantar protests will continue to see mass arrests, with thousands of people detained by the end of the protests, mostly in India.
I predict that there will be further clashes between protestors and police in New York City involving similar incidents with immigration agents.
